# oracle_vxd8_pnf.txt - the file tsanpr.dll reads AFTER the fingerprint lookup.
#
# Answers to the licensed-machine questions in HANDOFF.md, from the machine whose
# native run authenticates (value name 73e3e41855fba8d949120fe4ac51b3f4):
#   * C:/Windows/inf/vxd8.PNF  EXISTS - 2432 bytes (frozen below).
#   * C:/Windows/inf/vxd.PNF   does NOT exist -> its CreateFile failing is CORRECT.
#   * HKLM/SOFTWARE/Microsoft/Windows/CurrentVersion/Policies value 'profile'
#     is NOT present -> 'not present' is CORRECT. Neither vxd.PNF nor profile is a
#     missing input; vxd8.PNF is the only post-lookup input that was unrecorded.
#
# aarch64 confirmed the bytes matter (creating the file makes the engine ReadFile
# it, and placeholder contents still give (105)). Serve THESE bytes when the guest
# opens that path, same idea as oracle_iftable2.txt.
#
# What it is: NOT a licence secondary record - it holds no fingerprint/licence token
# in plaintext, its embedded FILETIMEs are ~2023 (older than the 2026 trial), and no
# vxd8.inf source exists. It is a genuine Windows precompiled-INF (PNF) that the
# licence SDK reads as an environment/device (HID-style) check, not a licence store.
# guest path = C:\Windows\inf\vxd8.PNF   size = 2432   entropy = 7.60 bit/byte
VXD8_PNF_RAW_HEX=
